paper_code_note: M||delta||^3/6 differentiates to (M/2)||delta||delta; official helper uses M/2. Pseudocode line uses L, so code convention retained.
privacy_counterexample: At student=old teacher all retained KD gradients are zero; the mixed aggregate is only the target gradient times its known coefficient.
independent_teacher_condition: With target-independent initialization, per-client random streams and no teacher feedback, excluding teacher A leaves exactly the target-free KD objective. Student optimization must restart independently of A.
